reasons.plausibility: While the simulation methods and phase discussions are not inherently contradictory, they do not directly address the actual TiVNbTa system or how to strengthen it at high temperature, leaving notable gaps.
reasons.testability: Although a range of computational and experimental comparisons are proposed, they do not clearly test any intervention to raise high-temperature strength in TiVNbTa, so they do not resolve the stated research question.
reasons.usefulness: Because it does not propose a direct means of preserving high-temperature strength in TiVNbTa or even address that alloy specifically, it offers limited practical guidance for the posed challenge.
